author: Codex, after AI-assisted feedback relayed by user

decisions.title: Model consumes recorded features
decisions.rationale: The executor and adapter prepare diagnostic identifiers and markers. The paired view omits raw HTML, arbitrary excerpts and server telemetry.
decisions.operational_effect: Use supplied identifiers and markers; do not request matcher reruns or template extraction inside the model.

decisions.title: Bound claims to observations
decisions.rationale: Technique indicators, candidate decisions and demonstrated data extraction are separate claims.
decisions.operational_effect: A failed indicator does not establish target safety; an indicator alone does not demonstrate extraction.

decisions.title: Do not invent timing causes
decisions.rationale: Paired durations and validity flags do not measure network jitter or server load independently.
decisions.operational_effect: Mention timing confounding as a limitation; assert a specific cause only when an appropriate measurement is supplied.

decisions.title: Use the declared marker mapping consistently
decisions.rationale: Marker meaning belongs to the project response mapping; upstream dynamic-page methods are conditional background.
decisions.operational_effect: Compare the supplied markers for both conditions; do not reinterpret unrelated page changes or invent a template-preparation stage.

decisions.title: Keep measurement rules in the common prompt
decisions.rationale: General references do not prescribe this project threshold, trial count or validity gates.
decisions.operational_effect: Apply the same project measurement and decision contract on both retrieval conditions; do not infer a new threshold from general references.
